name: Isocon Licitações Inteligentes
currentPhase: Local intelligence, edital ingestion and documentary compliance workflows
portfolioRole: A medium vertical product showing local AI and document intelligence inside a concrete commercial decision process.
headline: An installable procurement workspace that turns edital documents into requirements, risks and documentary actions.
challenge: A bidder repeatedly discovers opportunities, reads long edital documents, identifies mandatory conditions and searches distributed company records to prove compliance.
productResponse: Isocon synchronises the opportunity catalogue, extracts PDF text, analyses selected editais locally and materialises the result as requirements, risks, recommended actions and a requirement-to-document matrix.

actors.name: Bid analyst
actors.responsibility: Select opportunities, inspect requirements and coordinate readiness.

actors.name: Company administrator
actors.responsibility: Maintain corporate, CNAE and documentary information.

actors.name: Local intelligence
actors.responsibility: Interpret edital content under configurable criteria on the user's device.

productLayers.name: Catalogue
productLayers.description: Synchronised editais with search, selection, organisation, estimated value, date and locality.

productLayers.name: Company base
productLayers.description: Corporate identity, CNPJ, size, municipality, activity and CNAE used for fit analysis.

productLayers.name: Document base
productLayers.description: Company records prepared for requirement correlation.

productLayers.name: Analysis
productLayers.description: PDF extraction, local-model interpretation, requirements, risks and bidder actions.

productLayers.name: Compliance matrix
productLayers.description: Visible relation between each requirement, supporting document and current state.

productLayers.name: Local runtime
productLayers.description: PWA, SQL database, model cache and CPU/WebAssembly execution.

implemented: Local Gemma model preparation in browser CPU/WebAssembly

localIntelligence.dataBoundary: The model runs locally and the repository access credential is not sent to it.

evidence: The interface already exposes editais, company data, documents, analysis criteria, intelligence status and compliance matrix as connected operational pages.
The local model is prepared and cached separately from the procurement catalogue.
Requirement records include category, mandatory state, risk and recommended action.
The browser consumes a published catalogue instead of scraping the procurement portal during user interaction.
roadmap: Deepen edital sectioning and traceable source references
Improve documentary lifecycle and expiry controls
Add reviewed strategic summaries and follow-up states
Package production access and update policies
